newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Mortgage Agency sees 1997 bonds at $465 mln.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Mortgage Agency sees 1997 bonds at $465 mln.

text.p: The State of New York Mortgage Agency on Tuesday said it expects to issue approximately $465 million of bonds in 1997.
Stephen Hunt, president of the Mortgage Agency, also serves as president of the New York State Housing Finance Agency.
The Housing Finance Agency has issued almost $900 million of bonds in 1996, he said.
"(The) pipeline is well in excess of $800 million, which represents not-for-profit and private borrowers," he added in prepared remarks given at a conference sponsored by the Bond Buyer.
